one_liner: iPayX offers a Bearer-key REST FX audit API with OpenAPI 3.1, webhooks and an official MCP server; a free tier exists (5 lifetime audits / 10 per day on MCP), narrow scope.
auth_notes: Static Bearer token (ipx_live_ / ipx_test_) generated in the dashboard.
access_notes: Docs say MCP free tier is 10 audits/day per key; the pricing page gives 5 lifetime free audits. The API developer plan is $99/mo. Free credentials are enough to build and test, but the limits are tight and the sources conflict.
blocker_notes: Free usage is small and the docs are inconsistent (base URLs, tiers), but a key can be obtained self-serve.

evidence.quote: Every request requires a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header. Keys start with `ipx_live_`.
**Free tier:** 10 audits / day per API key.
Submit up to 50 FX transactions per request.
Officially listed on the MCP Registry (v1.3.3)
